about.rateLow: Low rates: slow-paced leveling, valuable gear and a long game.
about.rateMid: Medium rates: faster than official, but the game doesn’t fly by in a week.
about.rateHigh: High rates: fast leveling and battles that start soon.
about.rateMax: Very high rates: a character is ready for PvP almost right away.

account.title: Account
account.intro: Sign in to add your server to MMOTOP and manage it. Enter your email and we’ll send you a sign-in link — no password needed.
account.sent: We sent a sign-in link to {email}.
account.sentHint: Open it on this device. If the email isn’t there, check your spam folder.
account.tooMany: Too many attempts. Please try again in an hour.
account.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
account.noServers: You don’t have any servers yet. Add your first one — it shows up on the site once a moderator approves it.
account.recheck: If you change a listed server, it goes back to moderation.
account.moderation: A moderator reviews every new server and every change before it shows up on the site.
account.idTaken: That address is already taken. Choose another one.
account.invalid: Some fields aren’t filled in correctly. Please check them.

vote.nicknameHint: If the server rewards votes, the reward goes to this character.
vote.thanks: Thanks! Your vote counts. You can vote again in 12 hours.
vote.thanksRewarded: Thanks! Your vote counts, and the server has been told about your reward. You can vote again in 12 hours.
vote.tooSoon: You’ve already voted for this server. You can vote again: {time}.
vote.badNickname: A nickname is 2–32 letters, digits, spaces, periods, hyphens or underscores.
vote.captchaFailed: The check didn’t pass. Please try again.
vote.captchaLoad: The check couldn’t load. Reload the page and try again.
vote.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.
